candidates.description: This vector activates on common Thai conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical particles used to connect words and clauses.
This vector activates on the Thai consonant 'ม' (môo·mǎa) and words or subword tokens containing it.
This vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ท' (tho thahan) and its frequent combinations with various Thai vowels, tone marks, and surrounding characters.
This feature vector detects common Thai words, suffixes, and character combinations used in everyday language.
This feature activates for terms related to robotics, automated systems, and artificial intelligence across multiple languages.
This vector represents Thai language subwords, morphemes, and common Thai script fragments mixed with noisy foreign text strings.
This feature vector activates on a mixed set of multilingual subword fragments, numerical digits, and corporate brand tokens.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subword fragments from non-English languages and specialized proper nouns.
This feature vector captures a noisy mix of Thai script fragments and English subword tokens.
This vector represents common short phonetic substrings, vowel-consonant combinations, or character n-grams found across multiple natural languages.
